canonical_reference: Enevoldsen et al., MMTEB: Massive Multilingual Text Embedding Benchmark, ICLR 2025
evidence_note: Over 500 embedding evaluation tasks across 250+ languages aggregated community-wide from existing datasets; constituent origins are mixed and no majority is stated.

canonical_reference: Adelani et al., IrokoBench: A New Benchmark for African Languages in the Age of Large Language Models, NAACL 2025
evidence_note: Human-translated benchmark for low-resource African languages covering NLI, mathematical reasoning and knowledge QA; abstract states 17 languages while the contributions list states 16 (source-internal inconsistency).

canonical_reference: Asai et al., BUFFET: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Few-shot Cross-lingual Transfer, NAACL 2024
evidence_note: Few-shot cross-lingual transfer benchmark unifying 15 tasks across 54 languages; constituent datasets mix translation, in-language annotation and automatic alignment, so no majority origin is determinable.
